notes: Medium. Core is a git-like reachability walk over a content-addressed store combined with a self-hash verification (filename must equal sha256 of canonical payload) and regex credential scanning confined to reachable blobs. Difficulty lives in hidden-case generalization (must handle arbitrary stores) plus adversarial fixtures: corrupt objects, objects stored under mismatched filenames, a dangling or missing refs/HEAD, an AKIA/PRIVATE-KEY-style credential intentionally placed in an unreachable blob that must not be reported. Quantitative correctness is required to recompute digests from decoded bytes and report sorted unique IDs.
